title: Adapter conformance checks
one_line: Know when a coding tool update breaks its briefcase connection.
verified_against: Claude Code 2.1.330 (real install: connect, mcp list/get, plugin validate, doctor, and real telemetry mapped to records through a local stub model API); Codex CLI 0.171.0 (real install: config accepted by mcp list/get and doctor, no telemetry); Gemini CLI 0.70.0 (real install: settings load without error only, no telemetry); Copilot CLI 1.0.114 (real install, print-only adapter, docs-only); Cursor and VS Code Copilot (not installed, docs only). The GitHub workflow has been parsed as YAML but never run on GitHub.
